environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 instance. Audit logs written to /var/log/app/audit.log and consumed by Splunk Universal Forwarder configured with line-breaking on newline characters. Splunk alerts trigger on patterns like 'status=failed' with count > 5 to detect brute-force signing attempts, and 'SIGN_COMPLETE' entries are used for billing reconciliation. No input sanitization middleware. Application runs behind a basic nginx reverse proxy with no request body inspection.

config.log_consumer: Splunk Universal Forwarder with props.conf LINE_BREAKER=(\r?\n)
config.alerting: Splunk saved search on audit.log for anomaly detection
config.network: nginx reverse proxy, no WAF, no body inspection
config.hsm: Thales Luna Network HSM 7, PKCS#11 interface
